reviews.title: Worst Security & Tech Support Amidst Compromised Account
reviews.text: Do not use this company. There is no security/ fraud tech support.. no matter how they describe in faqs or documented “recovery processes”. My company’s email admin was breached by internal employee who was terminated. I have gone round and round with their email support as they do not have any live support that can assist. My account has now been compromised and abused, and they still are incapable of resolving for us. We are in the process of stopping payment on the credit card as that is the only way to resolve at this point.

We have a notification on the app that won’t go away when we have notifications. We have had Godaddy for over 10 years and haven’t been happy with it at all. reviews.title: It’s just an app to host browser links
reviews.text: It’s a completely unnecessary app. Nearly every single section within the app is just a direct link to the website, so there is no point in having the app. Both the app and the website are littered with constant ads trying to sell you on new GoDaddy products. If you click a section within the app, it opens up a browser window and at the top of the browser, every single time, is a giant pop-up, covering the menu buttons asking you to download the app you just used to get to this page. Good luck trying to find anything on the website itself, as they have loaded every page with marketing gimmicks and useless products. Just use their bloated website and avoid installing this data harvester on your device.

It’s a terrible app as it does little to support the main site.  I find myself always having to get to a pc to accomplish anything quickly.

reviews.title: Clunky and could be better!
reviews.text:
This app has mostly been reliable for getting calls and messages through but could be a way better and more consistent user experience.  I like the option to email notify with a voicemail transcript. 

They just switched to a new app and it does the same stuff as the old one.

The main issues that irritate me are:

It does not remove items from notifications once viewed so it always looks like you have tons of undead messages when you don’t and can be hard to keep track of. 

It will send you like 3 push notifications for the same item so it clogs up your screen. 

It will log you out randomly. 

It won’t load voicemails consistently so you have to exit that screen and go back to see if it will load the voicemail so you can see/hear it.

reviews.title: TERRIBLE GRAPHICS AND MORE
reviews.text:
I had this app when it was called “Over” and it was fantastic!! I used this app to create graphics and flyers, not to buy a domain, accept payments, and contact customers like it does now. Since the app was sold to GoDaddy and renamed “Studio,” they have completely changed the original apps purpose and it has gotten progressively worse. To name a few flaws: It’s glitchy, attempts to ‘sync’ your work to some cloud, has many fonts that aren’t even legible, a ‘Graphics’ selection that is mostly business oriented, incorrect English, and b&w/monochrome. It is no longer geared toward marketing normal US holidays or events, and some of the basic editing features simply don’t work correctly. GoDaddy doesn’t know that a real life photo of something is not a graphic, it’s a photo and they also do not understand the concept of an overlay. For reference, I AM a Pro subscriber but not sure how much longer I will be.

Before you subscribe, let me say this one more time: THE GRAPHICS SELECTION IS TERRIBLE and mostly USELESS!! GoDaddy claims “Retro Psychedelia” to be a “Trends” graphic selection.

*Be sure you sort reviews by most recent or you’ll be deceived by the previous owner’s 5-Star reviews. I am assuming GoDaddy only purchased a successful graphic design app so they could completely change it and still have the previous company’s great reviews.

reviews.title: 3 YEARS DOWN THE DRAIN
reviews.text: Since the recent updates GoDaddy has been impossible to work with it does not keep track of products anymore so if there’s only one left in quantity 5 can be ordered it has deleted orders but kept the customers money that ordered during updates and removed all history of the orders (only found out through my customers messaging me) put our personal number and email on order forms without our permission, put off sale items back on the shop that have been discontinued and had no inventory, got rid of our usps account and now we can’t even use usps had no shipping options for weeks so we couldn’t receive a single order. Merged both of our company names together on order form is literally been months without any improvement. We still have to print out all of our orders just to keep quantity by ourselves because our website can’t even provide that basic tool. We are jumping ship and changing to a different website. Absolutely terrible experience would not recommend also they are getting rid of the communication tool so it’ll be impossible to communicate with customers on the website now from your phone and it’s also not even accessible to do things from your phone like it used to be. I used to be able to edit our whole website from my phone and now I can barely do that from the website browser on a computer.

reviews.title: I WOULD NEVER suggest GoDaddy, ever
reviews.text: Have been having issues with GoDaddy for DECADES within the IT industry. “Oh I’m sorry but we can’t allow you to copy the server contents and move that information, sir.” all the way to when my father in law died, and they wouldn’t release the database information WHICH HELD RECORD of PAYMENTS made to the State of Texas JUIDICIAL/Criminal Justice System, and no one cared. At all. I eventually threw my hands up, and gave up. The business obviously pulled its contract, and went elsewhere… and GoDaddy says they’re not responsible in ANY way. I think we’re about to take them through the Criminal Justice system and see how sound that is. I can’t believe we lost an entire BUSINESS because they wouldn’t help us with my husband’s dead dad’s accounts. We even sent over copies of his information and death cert — absolutely NO traction, and it was disgustingly disrespectful at the time when it happened. It made my husband feel useless, and losing his dad’s business really hurt him. No one at GoDaddy to this DAY will admit their fault, and not a SOUL has tried to fix it. Generic BS replies from the “people” we “talk” to. It’s sad… the whole scenario was sad, and then dealing with GoDaddy will eventually become a sad affair at some point. Avoid them at all costs.

reviews.title: Poor

When things go wrong (which they do), it directly impacts your business and clients. Not reliable enough for a business-critical service. Think twice before committing.
